name: eigen-stem-trrr
bijnaam: Eigen stem, verhalend (proef BlackswanVault 20 nov 2026, opname 'Trrr')
description: Storytelling voice. The owner's own voice (recording 'Trrr', 20 Nov 2026; owner: 'Stem is van mij'), cloned with OmniVoice with the owner's permission. Reference = the full 15.9 s recording; only on the owner's pc (ref_pc), not on GitHub (public repo).
ref_text: Just before seven in the morning, high in the mountains east of San Diego, a group of migrants walked along a quiet road right next to the border with Mexico. They did not know that they were being watched, and they did not know that four men were about to stop them on that road.
